faq.q: Does this support all Markdown features?
faq.a: It handles common syntax: headings, paragraphs, bold, italic, links, inline code, and unordered lists. Advanced features like tables or footnotes are not included.
No. The conversion runs entirely in your browser using plain JavaScript. Your text never leaves your device.
